[[File:Blumbushpic.jpg|thumb|150px|A bush.]]
A '''bush''' was a type of woody shrub, distinguishable from a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] by its multiple, shorter stems which grow from or near the base, and was a common [[Plant/Legends|plant]] on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] grew on bushes that were found on many planets, including [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and [[Reytha]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
